title: T1 — Telegram reliability/privacy: durable relay outbox and retire legacy public DM inbox
desc: Owner-requested night audit found: (1) Ach/Leo/Brasidas were missing from encrypted token map; fixed with old mappings preserved, verified main-group test delivery. (2) Offline repro: a 31-message event sends only 30; next event does not retain the omitted message. (3) Legacy Pericles DM ingest writes telegram/dm-inbox.jsonl inside PUBLIC chatcode and promises an unavailable agent will reply. Scope for reviewed follow-up: durable idempotent outbox/retry with burst and failure controls; safe private-DM retirement/redirection while preserving public group ingress; avoid duplicate polling of Brasidas private bot; accurate automated receipts. Do not delete historical records or rotate shared secrets silently. Immediate mitigation: use private Brasidas inbox, old bot description warns, old nightwatch paused. Two independent reviewers required for production code changes.

history.note: Audit and immediate mitigations complete. Production code repair needs a reviewed durable-delivery/private-inbox migration plan; not falsely marked implemented. Existing main Telegram bridge remains enabled.
